'''Wenmo''' {{Lang|zh=椋羽}} is a Artisan seen doing maintenance on two Autopuppets. However, to the dismay of a passing [[Xun|citizen]], he is sitting down whilst doing so and is out of sight with the two odd moving Autopuppets. 

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Dialogue==
:{{DIcon}} What are you doing here?

:'''Wenmo''': Oh, I'm testing the motion coordination of these two Autopuppets. They just finished maintenance two days ago. Need to run them in again.

:'''Wenmo:''' Hmm... I'm not seeing any major issues. A few more days, and they should be ready to hand over to the Ministry of War.
{{Dialogue End}}
